fusions.name: Acrid Lash
fusions.desc: A weapon strike that deals 4 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Bitter Harvest
fusions.desc: Hooks the tip into an enemy up to 6 tiles away, which deals 18 damage, up to 1.5 times that at full reach. It draws out every affliction you have on the target and deals 60% more damage for each one drawn.

fusions.name: Tourniquet Pull
fusions.desc: Draws up to 3 poison conditions out of you and out of each of your allies, and restores 10 health to you.

fusions.name: Venom Into Tonic
fusions.desc: When you afflict an enemy, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds. You have 8% poison resistance.
